message.content:
I don’t have access to live clock data, so I can’t give you the exact current time right now.  
If you need the precise time in New York City, you can check a reliable world‑clock website, your phone’s clock set to the “New York” time zone, or use a command like:

```bash
timedatectl | grep "Time zone"
```

On June 20, 2026, New York is observing Eastern Daylight Time (UTC‑4), so you can calculate the local time by subtracting four hours from UTC.
